## Type

- [ ] New / updated resource
- [ ] Tooling (scripts, tests, CI)
- [ ] Documentation

## Resource checklist (skip for tooling-only PRs)

- [ ] Source URL, original path and commit recorded in front matter
- [ ] Author credited (when known)
- [ ] License is explicit and allows redistribution
- [ ] Row added to `NOTICE.md` with the copyright line copied verbatim
- [ ] Tested in Antigravity (version: ___ ) — or left as `status: draft`
- [ ] No secrets, no data exfiltration; dangerous commands justified

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run validate`
